utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a few things by, though I’ll need to keep it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — what can you bring today, and when should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring some canned food and a few clean blankets by late afternoon. I’ll leave them at your door so I don’t overcomplicate things.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me the plan and when you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — I’m pulling the list together now, and I’ll send you the plan and time as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Cleo. I’ll keep my calendar open and wait for your message.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is getting some good momentum. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone who might want to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll mention it if I hear anyone asking around. Hope the drive keeps picking up steam.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll make sure I’ve got the details right before I help—what part of the repair drive should I focus on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you focus on the donation drop-off and let folks know where to bring any repair items?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll point people to the donation drop-off and tell them where to bring repair items.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m thinking Saturday morning, around 9 if that works. I can bring my toolbox and a couple extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me—I’ll plan around the school schedule. Thanks for bringing the toolbox and extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re trying to get a few things fixed up before the weekend—pretty good turnout so far, too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard that too. I’m glad folks are showing up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Me too—last I heard they still need a few hands for the heavier stuff, so I might swing by after lunch and see what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where everyone’s dropping things off for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be a huge help, thanks—just point folks to the usual spot and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll direct everyone to the usual drop-off spot and make sure it stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m worried about the timing and how we’ll get everything there. Do we know who’s bringing what and when we need it done?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can ask around and repeat the plan to everyone, then we’ll line up who brings what and have it ready on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — please keep me posted once you’ve got the list and timing sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What should I take on first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — could you start by sorting the donation drop-off list? I think that’s the first thing we need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donation drop-off list first and keep you posted if I run into anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam — that’s lovely of you. I’ll swing by with the details and let you know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — just bring the list by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive locations if you want—just tell me where it starts and where we’re headed next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Opal — it starts at my place on Maple and then we’re heading over to the Harris house next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Maple first, then the Harris house. I’ll keep those stops straight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who can chip in. Just let me know what Nell wants me to share.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — please tell folks we’re gathering people who can help with tools, time, or parts for the repair drive, and they can reach out to me with whatever they’re able to offer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll pass that along and encourage folks to reach out to you with whatever they can offer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — just send me the basics and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll grab the basics and keep you posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep it short and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the part about where to drop off the repair stuff?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries — we’re still sorting it out. I’ll point you to the drop-off spot and the list in just a moment.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’m here now and can help wherever you need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I was meaning to check on that; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you help confirm the pickup time and whether we’ve got enough boxes? I’m just trying to make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can check on the pickup time, and I’ll count up the boxes too. If we’re short, I can grab a few more.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your toolkit and maybe a couple of gloves? That would really help us get started.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing — I’ll bring my toolkit and a couple of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I’m a bit fuzzy, Mina, but I think the safest first step is to check what’s most broken and easiest to fix quickly. Maybe we can start with the loose handrail and that leaky faucet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense. Which one should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can bring over my toolbox and help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus. What time were you thinking, and should I check if we need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about I swing by around 6? If you can, just check whether we need extra screws, tape, or a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to the others and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive and make sure the plan stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I’m ready to get the repair drive organized and keep things moving for the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Rosa — I’ll help sort the items and keep track of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll make a simple list and we can mark each repair as we go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s happening. I’ll bring the tools and we can sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’re sure the tools are enough, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. I can help however you need—just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Rey—thank you. Could you start by checking the donation list and setting aside any tools we still need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely—I’ll check the donation list and set aside anything missing right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m already telling folks — I can swing by and spread the word if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Quinn. Thanks for spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the folks on Maple and then check in with the block chat. If you need anything else for the drive, just say the word.
